items.lang|foxablazeaqzl_wiki|foxablazeaqzl_wi:
Use this skill to manipulate friends and foes,compelling them to act according to your will.

All activations are accompanied by a screech sound effect - Doesn’t work on Spiritual Lifeforms or those under the effects of Rampage.
Active
[Active - Press] Target: Turns the looked at mob into an ally for 10 Minutes. Costs 50 MP, negated by Spiritual Attack Nullification. Reduced to 5 Minutes by Resistance.
Active: [Active - Press] Area: Turns all mobs within a 20x20 (30x30 with Mastery) radius into allies for 5 Minutes. Costs 80 MP per mob. Negated by Spiritual Attack Nullification. Reduced to 2.5 Minutes by Resistance.
Active: [Active - Press] Charm: Applies a "Hero of the Village V" effect for 2 Minutes to the player. Costs 200 MP.
Active: [Active - Press] Kill: Kills all mobs (that is under mind control) within a 20x20 (30x30 with Mastery) Radius. Costs 100 MP per mob. Negated by Spiritual Attack Nullification. Deals half hp in damage with resistance. - Cooldown: 5s (3s with mastery)

"You seek to build a world of Truths. Are you prepared to scorch and burn everything in your path to make the truthful world you seek so badly?"

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Turboblaze - Increases damage of all Fire-based attacks by 2x. Stacks with Flame Manipulation and Flame Domination.
Active
[Active, Press] Blue Flare - On activation, the user surrounds the area they are looking at in blue flames dealing 60 damage for as long as targets stay inside it. On impact, it creates a 20x20 zone. Cooldown of 10 seconds, 5 with mastery. Costs 400 MP to use.
Active: [Active, Press] Fusion Flare - Costs 400 MP to use. The user strikes where they are looking with a massive flame, scorching all those trapped, pulling them towards the center of it dealing 40 Flame attack damage per second, lasting 5 seconds.
If the user has the Unique Skill [Zekrom] in slot, additionally summon lightning down to strike the user’s target, dealing 40 Electricity Damage, if this happens, the cost is increased to 700 MP. 20 Second CD
Active: [Active, Press] Draconic Meteor - Costs 400 Magicules to use. Using draconic power, the user forms a meteor and brings it down from the sky, striking down at the targeted zone dealing 70 Magic Damage, destroying surrounding blocks and knocking everything back. 20 second cooldown.
Active: [Active, Hold] Flamethrower - Cost 70 Magicules per second while active. Works like Flame Breath, instead dealing 30 fire damage each second.

Burst forth with great speed and power, enhancing your abilities for a short period of time.

Active
[Active, Press] It allows the user to gain 0.1F more movement speed and 12.0F attack damage for a short period of time. 600 second cooldown. 300 when mastered.

Bend reality to ensure your enemies meet their demise by ignoring their dodge and barriers.

Passive
[Passive] Certain Outcome: When toggled, all attacks made by the player become critical hits automatically. When in-slot, attacks made by the player shatter all barrier points unless the target has Law Manipulation or an Ultimate Skill and has an EP more than 2X the player's.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Optimal Action: The player's attacks ignore all forms of dodge. Learning and Mastering abilities grants +4 learning points. Nullification is treated as resistance and resistance is bypassed.
Active
[Active - toggle] Chaotic Fate (Requires Learning): When activated, makes the damage of the player's next attack reduce the target's max hp by the amount of damage dealt. Crouching and using chaotic fate will undo all permanent damage done with chaotic fate to the user, looking at a mob will do it to them. When activated with mastery, it will turn into a active - press ability

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Chant Reduction - If a spell is not mastered, your cast speed is incredibly reduced through the spirits assistance.
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Chant Annulment - You no longer require chanting to cast any magic if the spell is mastered.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Spiritfarer - The spirits protect you, reducing all magic and spiritual damage by 25%. Physical attacks are reduced by 10%.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Leyline Connection - All magicule consumption is halved.
Passive: [Passive, True] Harvester - Passively gain Souls through kills, even if you are not a Majin.
Active
[Active, Press] Carve - Spin the Ritual Scythe, harvesting Souls in an area around you. The amount of souls gained is dependent on the damage dealt. Cooldown of 10 seconds. Earn 1 mastery point on usage.
The Soul formula is as follows:
(Mainhand Weapon Damage + Base Atk Dmg) x Critical Multiplier (typically 1.5) / 5
Active: [Active, Scroll] Enhance - The souls of the dead help you. While holding down this mode, scroll to choose a percentage of your souls to use on your next Magic/Spiritual attack which will boost it's damage by that percentage, +10%.
Example:
Solar Rain deals 30 per bolt. Assume you have 8 bolts in one usage of Solar Rain. By default, this will deal 30 x 8 = 240 damage. Using 100% of your souls, you will deal +33 (110%) for each bolt resulting in 63 x 8 = 504 damage. If I set the level to 50%, it would instead be +60% damage. So on, so forth.

Use your sensitive hearing to precisely pin the location of any nearby mobs which make sound.

[Active - Hold] - While held down, any mobs that emits sound within a 60 block radius will be highlighted in green [Togglable if mastered, with only 40 block radius].

Transform your skin into scales which become tougher as you gain more EP

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Grants the user armour with effectiveness dependent on their EP. Base is equal to Pure Magisteel, 400,000+ is equal to Adamantite, and 800,000+ is equal to Hihiirokane.

Once a day, draw out your monstrous potential to double your EP and to boost your physical prowess. Doing this will leave a temporary toll on your body.

Active
[Active - Press] - On activation, grants the user a temporary 2x increase to their max Magicules and Aura; 20 Armor Points; a Strength 4 Effect and +0.05 Speed. It lasts for 3 Minutes and upon ending inflicts the player with Paralysis 2, Fragility 2, and Weakness 2 for 10 Minutes. It can only be used once a day. Mastery increases the duration to 6 Minutes.
Can't be activated along with the following skills
Beast Transformation
Ogre Berserker
Magic Flame Transform
Magic Water Transform
Magic Wind Transform
Magic Earth Transform
Magic Space Transform
Magic Light Transform
Magic Darkness Transform

Active
[Active - Hold] - Same as Analytical Appraisal but with the zoom effect like Farsight [Max: x100].

Move freely through space, teleport large distances or create spatial gates. Manipulate stardust to immense damage.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle + In Slot] - Spatial Manipulation: x2 Spatial Damage [Toggle] & Warp Shot [In Slot while in this Mode]
When active, non-magic projectiles (Arrows, Spear, Kunai, Sniper Bullet, Web Bullet, Potions, Thrown Item (from Thrower), Egg, Ender Pearl, Firework Rocket, Snowball, Trident) will automatically warp to the back of the looked-at target's head and shot at the speed of the original speed multiplied by the warp shot level. Sneak to not warp shot while shooting. Cost 50 MP each warp.
When activated, grant the user warp shot level of 0.5. Press again to deactivate. (Stackable)
Active
[Active - Press] - Instant Motion: Teleports the player to where they're looking instantly. Costs 5 MP per block distance. Range 200 Blocks. 5 Seconds Cooldown.
Active: [Active - Press] - Teleport: Opens Spatial Motion GUI. Costs 5 MP per block distance for instant warp, 25 per for portal. 10 second cooldown(5 with mastery)
Active: [Active - Press] - Stardust Arrow (Requires Learning): Launches a singular energy arrow where the player is looking that deals 30 damage and applies severance [Sneak to apply warp shot on the arrow]. Costs 100 MP and 100 AP.
Active: [Active - Press] - Stardust Rain (Requires Mastery + Learning): Launches energy arrows from 360⁰ in a sphere around the looked at enemy [Radius: 20 Blocks]. Costs 5000 AP and 5000 MP. Each arrow does 30 Damage and applies a Severance effect [Around 10-12 arrows at once]. 5 second cooldown(4 seconds with mastery)

Empower your attacks with the effect of Paralysis, with mastery you can do this automatically.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] - Inflicts Paralysis onto target [Togglable if mastered]. 0MP

Channel your inner paralysis to emit paralyzing enzymes that make your target go numb from just your presence

Active
[Active, Hold] Paralysis Transform: At the cost of 50% speed, deal 2 paralysis damage and apply "Paralysis" for all mobs within a 10x10 radius

Spew a horrifying breath to paralyze your prey.

Active
[Active - Hold] - Breath attack that applies Paralysis effects to all targets touched (with 14 damage each sec). Costs 50 MP per 20 Ticks

Absorb your enemies, gain new powers, and break down anything that stands in your way.

Active
[Active - Press] Predation: On use, creates a black mist (breath) in a 2 block radius in front of the player. If it comes into contact with a mob, deals 10 damage and drains 100MP, with a 10% chance to gain one random Intrinsic, Common, Extra, or Resist skill from the target. If an enemy is killed by Predation, gains all of their Intrinsic, Common, Extra, and Resist skills. With Mastery, the mist is capable of eating projectiles. Targets killed have 30% (Configurable) of their ep added to the players instead of the usual 5%This only applies the first time a type of mob is eaten. i.e. This bonus will only apply the first time you eat a Armorsaurus. The other 50% will be added to Stomach's energy storage. Shift-activate to toggled on/off consume-block-mode, which will automatically be added to Stomach. (EP absorb only applies for the first target of that type)
Active: [Active - Hold] Corrosion: When activated while looking at nothing, costs 200 MP and deals 5 corrosion damage every 10 ticks to all enemies in a 10x10 radius. Enemies killed by this have their Intrinsic, Common, and Extra Skills taken by the player as well as have 30% (Configurable) of their ep added to the player's maximum.
Active: [Active - Press] Stomach: When activated, grants access to a spatial storage with the size of a chest with 7 rows. Items are able to be stacked to 200 instead of 64.
Active: [Active - Press] Receive: When activated while looking at a subordinate: Resistances, Intrinsic, Common and Extra skills owned by it are given to the player.

Use your inherent power to turn your opponents neutral or to temporarily dominate weak opponents.

Active
[Active - Press] - Ineffective on targets with Spiritual Null or with an EP over 50% (30 if target has Spiritual Resist) of the user’s Max EP. Turns Targets between 25% and 50% Neutral (5 - 30 if target has Spiritual Resist), and turns targets below 25% (5 if target has Spiritual Resist) Max EP into temporary allies for 5 minutes (10 with Mastery). Costs 80 MP + Target’s EP [Looking at Target in 5 block radius, Shift to undo]
